Project planning2 min read

A clearer brief. A better transformer enquiry.

A useful instrument-transformer enquiry starts with the application, not just a product name. Bringing a few key details together gives the manufacturer a better basis for reviewing your requirement.

1. Define the job

Explain whether the CT or PT is intended for metering, monitoring or protection, and identify the equipment it will serve. A device chosen for one application may have different requirements from a device used for another.

2. Share the electrical requirements

Include the primary and secondary values required by your project. For CT selection, the primary-current range must suit the application. List the required accuracy and burden together rather than treating either as a standalone number.

For a PT or VT, identify the voltage-measurement application and its accuracy and burden requirements. Attach the relevant equipment data so the review is based on the actual interface.

3. Describe the physical fit

Where a window-type CT is being considered, the opening needs to suit the primary conductor. In any installation, include the available space and the relevant mechanical drawings. This helps turn a broad enquiry into a discussion about a practical configuration.

4. Put the information in one place

The following enquiry outline is an editorial planning aid. Complete it using your project documents:

  • Application: metering, monitoring or protection, with the equipment reference.
  • Required ratings: the primary and secondary values in the project specification.
  • Performance: required accuracy and burden, supported by equipment data.
  • Installation: indoor or outdoor location, space constraints and interface drawings.
  • Project documents: the relevant specification, quantity and delivery requirement.

Make the next conversation useful

Missing details are easier to resolve when they are visible. Mark any open points in your enquiry and ask the manufacturer to review them with you. Use the approved project specification and manufacturer data to confirm the final selection.
